FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Pawsitive Care Veterinary Services, we provide comprehensive veterinary care focused on companion animals, including routine medical examinations, diagnostics, and minor surgical procedures. Our facility is designed with secure and well-maintained animal containment areas that adhere to all local animal welfare standards, ensuring a safe environment for both our patients and staff. We employ a team of licensed veterinarians and credentialed veterinary technicians, ensuring that all medical procedures are conducted by qualified professionals. Additionally, we maintain robust protocols for waste handling, including compliant disposal of biohazard and sharps materials. As a part of our commitment to safety and quality care, we regularly maintain and calibrate our diagnostic and surgical equipment. Our operations are structured to minimize risk, and we do not provide large-scale boarding services, focusing instead on short-term care that adheres to all regulatory requirements. This careful approach helps us maintain a clean regulatory record and a strong safety history.
